text: A finer finish: titles in an editorial serif and text in a Paris-house sans; the lock is frosted glass with a gold and platinum bezel and a small diamond; gold catches the light as you tilt the phone; every key springs back with a ripple of light.
The lock screen is a real night sky: twinkling stars, the Milky Way, a distant galaxy, meteors and now and then a comet, behind a polished gold seal. Gold buttons now look like real polished metal.
The More menu now rises on glass: in dark mode a midnight sky with twinkling stars and gold-edged keys that catch the light; in light mode pearl and gold.
A calmer, richer look shared with the Life OS: a night-sky header with a gold crest, a gold main action, and the Programme wheel scored by tapping keys (your choice shows in jade) instead of a list.
Languages: the app follows your device in हिंदी or मराठी (beta), or choose one in Settings. More screens are being translated.
One open action: Today shows the one next step chosen by risk; everything else waits under Later. Rhythm folds reviews that are not due yet, and a long register can show only the vital few (80/20).

Your review rhythm can live in your calendar: Rhythm > Add the rhythm to my calendar adds each review as a repeating event, with its checklist inside. A newer file updates those events, it never doubles them.
Vantage is here: your next step, leadership rituals, the review rhythm, top risks, decisions, exceptions, tools, KPIs and KRIs, playbooks and progress.
Principles now come from the estate's one shared list: when one improves, every app gets it at its next update. See them in Settings.
